text:
You need a backend that plugs into your existing front-end and powers fast, reliable legal document drafting with AI.

I’m Noor Halden, with 6 years of experience in Python, machine learning, NLP, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, PyTorch, scikit-learn, XGBoost, and pandas. I’ve built production AI backends that need clean integration and careful handoff logic.

For Parcelwise Logistics, I built a WhatsApp and SMS assistant for parcel tracking and delivery rescheduling; 43% of conversations were resolved without an agent. For Strata Engineering Group, I built an on-premise question-answering assistant over 14k pages of engineering standards; it achieved an 82% top-3 hit rate on 60 engineer questions.

I can move quickly on your 10-day timeline, implement the backend, and connect it cleanly to the front-end.
